items.author: NISHIKANT KARLIKAR
items.description: A Bhiwandi businessman suffered severe injuries in 2016 when a speeding truck ran over him. His left leg was subsequently amputated below the knee after medical treatment. The award included 9% annual interest and directed payment from both the truck owner and insurance company.

items.title: Train delay makes Jammu couple miss flight, Railways ordered to pay Rs 63,199
items.author: SAURABH THAKUR
items.description: Northern Railways has been directed to compensate a Jammu couple for missing their flight. They missed their flight after the Delhi Duronto Express train was delayed for nearly four hours. The couple incurred expenses for new flight tickets and hotel accommodation. A district consumer court ruled in their favor, citing deficiency of service by the railways. The railways failed to provide evidence justifying the delay caused by fog.
